issues_found: The previous primary was a saturated violet — the most recognisable AI-default accent. Replaced with petrol.
`⟳ Rotate` failed label-content-name-mismatch because axe counts the text glyph in the visible label; the chevrons and the rotate glyph are now aria-hidden icons.
The audit only catches this class of problem when the document viewer is mounted; running it before the PDF loads would have missed it.
The environment cannot screenshot, so the look needs a human eye at lg+.
